authority: The operator explicitly approved setting the proposed bounded goal and executing verification. This admits a separate source-displayed readout diagnostic, not a revised PAH model or replacement cylinder algebra.
question: For every fixed admitted h,N, fixed parent-domain real parameters with epsilon>0, every fixed bounded Lipschitz gauge/anchor-invariant local displayed-field readout F, and every finite T, is sup_(0<=t<=T)||S_r(t)f_r-f_r||_(L2(pi_r)) -> 0 as r->infinity, with f_r=F(s_r,psi_r,U_r)?

fixed_scope.geometry: Exactly the adopted finite open square G_(h,N), with its source anchors, stored orientations and all elementary faces; fix h,N before r. No new carrier.
fixed_scope.parameters: All original real parameters fixed across r, including 0<epsilon<=1, beta>0, nu>0, positive source couplings and finite possibly negative m2/lambda4. Fixed R0>0 and integers 1<=q0<=m0.
fixed_scope.cutoffs: K_r is product of the first r+1 primes; M_s=2^r, M_psi=m0*4^r, Rmax=R0*2^r, Q=q0*2^r. All hidden integer labels and all valid signed PH/TR/LK/AP roots retained.
fixed_scope.state: Original full tuple counting Gibbs pi_r=exp(-beta F_r)/Z_r; no conditional, quotient, fitted or replacement state.
fixed_scope.dynamics: Original full finite generator on C^(Omega_r), S_r(t)=exp(t L_r). Rates and mobility from the pinned parent; stationary initial-time convention and original external stochastic time.
fixed_scope.displayed_metric: d((s,psi,U),(s',psi',U'))=sum_v |s_v-s'_v|+sum_v |psi_v-psi'_v|+sum_e |U_e-U'_e|, using complex chord distance, not integer-label or discontinuous principal-angle distance.
fixed_scope.readouts: One fixed bounded complex-valued F on the displayed-field space, Lipschitz with an r-independent finite constant in the declared metric, invariant under gauge and source-preserving anchor automorphisms. Quantification is over every such fixed F, not uniform over unbounded Lipschitz constants.
fixed_scope.sampling: Direct evaluation on each Omega_r only. Not an assertion that these sampled f_r are the old fixed CRT cylinder or that an inter-cutoff common Hilbert space exists.
fixed_scope.order: Only r->infinity at each fixed h,N and epsilon. No h/N/epsilon/beta limit or interchange.

separate_nontriviality.readout: F_star=|P|^(-1) sum_(p in P) Re product_(e in boundary p) U_e^(orientation sign), using every elementary plaquette. This is derived from the existing plaquette term and is gauge/anchor-automorphism invariant.
separate_nontriviality.target: Derive an explicit r-independent positive lower bound for Var_(pi_r)(F_star,r) for all sufficiently large r, hence liminf_r Var>0. Per-cutoff positivity alone does not suffice.

acceptance.PROVED: Exact all-root, all-state analytic bounds with cutoff-independent constants imply the displayed universal freezing statement; separately prove the stated positive-variance bound. Primary, non-importing independent and hostile checks must pass; record feasible Lean scope honestly.
acceptance.DISPROVED: One exact fixed admitted readout/parameter tuple with a nonvanishing finite-time defect along an unbounded r sequence, preserving all declared data.
acceptance.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: One unresolved rate/jump/variance/semigroup inequality, with exact missing hypothesis and reentry condition. No automatic retries or weakened successor.
